description: Get a health summary of your LLM infrastructure in one call. Fetches 4 existing endpoints in parallel (aggregate_calls / get_percentiles / get_llm_budget / list_audit_log) and compresses them into one response. Returns { window, totals: {calls, costUsd, errorRate (percent 0-100)}, latency: {p50, p95, p99 (ms)}, budget: {used, limit, percentUsed (0-100)}, recentEvents: count, summary: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'critical', partialFailures?: string[] (axes that failed to fetch; omitted when everything succeeds) }. critical = errorRate>=10% / budget>=90% / p95>=10s; warn = >=3% / >=70% / >=3s. Example phrasing: "how is our LLM infra doing right now?" — answered in one prompt. Pure read aggregator (no new backend endpoint); individual endpoint failures return partial results (one axis timing out does not block the summary; failed axes are listed in partialFailures).
name: get_account_health
